$comment: Thresholds this project holds itself to. Loosening any value here changes toolchain_digest and invalidates every engineering receipt, because loosening a threshold is the only realistic attack on this gate.

contrast.$comment: WCAG 2.2. AA (4.5:1) is the floor everywhere. Reading-size prose at or above reading_px is held to the enhanced AAA ratio, because that is the text people read for comprehension. Ratios come from specified colours and are an upper bound on legibility, not a guarantee of it.

typography.$comment: OBSERVATORY.md: the canvas scrolls before text becomes tiny. AGENTS.md: expand lanes and boxes, not font degradation.
typography.$canvas_comment: Locked to node boxes authored in src/diagram-*.mjs and verified across 544 layers in 9 models. The 10.5/11.5/11.6px one-offs were retired by rounding down, which measured headroom showed to be free; rounding up would have left the two 176x32 pills about 1px of clearance. The canvas set is now a subset of the chrome scale, so a value can only be added here by re-authoring geometry.

layout.$comment: geometryReport tests intersection, so a 0.1px gap passes today. These are separation floors, not collision checks. The crossing budget is set just above the observed ceiling (5) so it is a live check; a budget far above what any scene produces cannot fail and is decoration.

spacing.$comment: A 2/4px rhythm. auto, percentages and calc() are not scale members and are not checked.

presentation.$comment: The portable artifact must stay small enough to open anywhere. External URLs are allowed as clickable source citations and forbidden in any loading position; README states plainly that source links require connectivity.
